clips.title: The story
paras: Supplying the Sepulcher is a logistical task issued by Deathguard Podrig at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. To keep the local Deathguard detachment equipped against feral horrors and Scourge prowling the woods, an urgent weapon requisition must be routed via bat handler Karos Razok toward weapon suppliers in the Undercity.

While Deathguard Podrig reports that the Sepulcher is relatively well-stocked, continuous attrition in Silverpine Forest consumes equipment at an alarming rate. Between feral beasts, prowling Scourge remnants, and aggressive local threats, frontline gear wears down or gets abandoned in skirmishes. Under orders from Executor Hadrec, Podrig drafts a direct requisition order addressed to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer operating out of the capital. Securing a steady flow of replacement blades and armor is essential if the Forsaken hope to retain their fragile footholds outside Tirisfal Glades.

Moving critical correspondence and military supplies through Silverpine's mist-choked roads on foot is slow and prone to ambush. To bypass these perils, the Forsaken rely on captive, trained vampire bats. Handing Podrig's requisition to bat handler Karos Razok integrates foot soldiers into the broader aerial logistics network of the Undercity, establishing the aerial transit lines that tie outlying garrisons directly to Sylvanas's capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher. With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.
I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity. Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You appear to be on official business...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, an order for supplies. You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt. And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
